verse.unicode: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪

transliteration.english: bilaaval kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa

en.bdb: Vaar Of Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

verse.unicode: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

transliteration.english: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥

transliteration.english: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||

en.bdb: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥

transliteration.english: har utam har prabh gaaviaa kar naadh bilaaval raag ||

en.bdb: I sing of the sublime Lord, the Lord God, in the melody of Raag Bilaaval.

verse.unicode: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥

transliteration.english: aupadhes guroo sun ma(n)niaa dhur masatak pooraa bhaag ||

en.bdb: Hearing the Guru's Teachings, I obey them; this is the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead.

verse.unicode: ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥

transliteration.english: sabh dhinas rain gun ucharai har har har ur liv laag ||

en.bdb: All day and night, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; within my heart, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

verse.unicode: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਬਾਗੁ ॥

transliteration.english: sabh tan man hariaa hoiaa man khiRiaa hariaa baag ||

en.bdb: My body and mind are totally rejuvenated, and the garden of my mind has blossomed forth in lush abundance.

verse.unicode: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ॥

transliteration.english: agiaan a(n)dheraa miT giaa gur chaanan giaan charaag ||

en.bdb: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, with the light of the lamp of the Guru's wisdom. Servant Nanak lives by beholding the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: jan naanak jeevai dhekh har ik nimakh ghaRee mukh laag ||1||

en.bdb: Let me behold Your face, for a moment, even an instant! ||1||

transliteration.english: mahalaa teejaa ||

en.bdb: Third Mehla:

verse.unicode: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥

transliteration.english: bilaaval tab hee keejeeaai jab mukh hovai naam ||

en.bdb: Be happy and sing in Bilaaval, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in your mouth.

verse.unicode: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥

transliteration.english: raag naadh sabadh sohane jaa laagai sahaj dhiaan ||

en.bdb: The melody and music, and the Word of the Shabad are beautiful, when one focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.

verse.unicode: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥

transliteration.english: raag naadh chhodd har seveeaai taa dharageh paieeaai maan ||

en.bdb: So leave behind the melody and music, and serve the Lord; then, you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: naanak gurmukh braham beechaareeaai chookai man abhimaan ||2||

en.bdb: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, contemplate God, and rid your mind of egotistical pride. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਪਉੜੀ ॥

transliteration.english: pauRee ||

en.bdb: Pauree:

verse.unicode: ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: too har prabh aap aga(n)m hai sabh tudh upaiaa ||

en.bdb: O Lord God, You Yourself are inaccessible; You formed everything.

verse.unicode: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: too aape aap varatadhaa sabh jagat sabaiaa ||

en.bdb: You Yourself are totally permeating and pervading the entire universe.

verse.unicode: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: tudh aape taaRee laieeaai aape gun gaiaa ||

en.bdb: You Yourself are absorbed in the state of deep meditation; You Yourself sing Your Glorious Praises.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: har dhiaavahu bhagatahu dhinas raat a(n)t le chhaddaiaa ||

en.bdb: Meditate on the Lord, O devotees, day and night; He shall deliver you in the end.

verse.unicode: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: jin seviaa tin sukh paiaa har naam samaiaa ||1||

en.bdb: Those who serve the Lord, find peace; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||
